title: Dinner, tea or supper? What Britain calls its evening meal
excerpt: 12,522 answers from the Our Dialects survey, mapped: tea in the north, dinner in the south, a tea line across the Midlands, and no sign of dinner moving north.
seo_description: Map of what Britain calls its evening meal: dinner, tea or supper, from 12,522 dialect survey answers, with the tea line and age trends.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Dinner, tea or supper?' in blue, brown and purple on cream, beside a map of Great Britain and Northern Ireland shaded brown where the evening meal is tea, across northern England and Wales, and blue where it is dinner, across the south, Glasgow and Northern Ireland, with a black line between them. Text: 12,522 survey answers on what Britain calls its evening meal.
